description:
v2.0 | 5177 gates | 18 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Multiplies two 32-bit numbers.

Use this circuit wherever a creation has to multiply two whole numbers, for example inside a calculator or in the arithmetic part of a computer.

It multiplies two unsigned binary numbers, a and b, which have the same size. The product is twice as wide as either input. Inputs and output are read least significant digit first.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): a = x 0-31, b = x 32-63.
Outputs (green gates): product = x 0-63.

Profile: efficient, the build with the lowest gates x ticks for this size.
How it works: Full adders in layers bring the columns down to two rows, then a fast adder.
Checked on about a million inputs in a simulator. The yellow input gates are not counted in the gates or the ticks: wire to them, or merge them away.
By: byggmesterPRO
